name: cartilage of pharyngotympanic tube
synonyms: cartilago tubae auditivae; cartilago tubae auditoriae
definition: A triangular plate of elastic fibrocartilage that forms the cartilage component of the pharyngotympanic tube.

name: bony part of pharyngotympanic tube
definition: The bony part of pharyngotympanic tube is about 12 mm. in length. It begins in the carotid wall of the tympanic cavity, below the septum canalis musculotubarii, and, gradually narrowing, ends at the angle of junction of the squama and the petrous portion of the temporal bone, its extremity presenting a jagged margin which serves for the attachment of the cartilaginous portion.

name: surface of tongue
definition: An anatomical surface that is part of a tongue.

name: superior surface of tongue
definition: The upper (superior) side of the tongue.

name: inferior surface of tongue
definition: The lower (inferior) side of the tongue.

name: roof of mouth
definition: A multi-tissue structure consisting of bone and soft tissue that forms a part of the roof of the oral cavity. In mammals this is the combination of the primary palate (premaxilla) and the secondary palate. In early tetrapods it consists of the vomer, pterygoid, parasphenoid, palatine and ectopterygoid bones.

name: outer epithelium
definition: The epidermis is the entire outer epithelial layer of an animal, it may be a single layer that produces an extracellular material (e.g. the cuticle of arthropods) or a complex stratified squamous epithelium, as in the case of many vertebrate species[GO].

name: enveloping layer of ectoderm
definition: Outermost layer of cells surrounding the embryo.

name: appendage lymph vessel
definition: A lymphatic vessel that is part of a limb/fin.

name: pectoral appendage lymph vessel
definition: A lymphatic vessel that is part of a pectoral appendage.

name: pelvic appendage lymph vessel
definition: A lymphatic vessel that is part of a pelvic appendage.

name: paired limb/fin cartilage
definition: A cartilage tissue that is part of a paired limb or fin.

name: pectoral appendage cartilage tissue
definition: A cartilage tissue that is part of a pectoral appendage.

name: pelvic appendage cartilage tissue
definition: A cartilage tissue that is part of a pelvic appendage.

name: nucleus of midbrain tegmentum
definition: A nucleus of brain that spans a midbrain tegmentum.

name: nucleus of midbrain reticular formation
definition: A nucleus of midbrain tegmentum that is part of a midbrain reticular formation.

name: neural decussation
definition: Nerve fibers crossing the midline of the neuraxis relative to their point of origin, on a course to from one level of the nervous system to another. (CUMBO, Heimer, L. The Human Brain, 2nd ed., 1995, pg 6).

name: decussation of diencephalon
definition: A neural decussation that is part of a diencephalon.

name: lumen of epithelial sac
definition: The space within an epithelial sphere.

name: matrix-based tissue
definition: A tissue whose predominant feature is extracellular matrix which may or may not be highly hydrated or calcified.

name: keratin-based acellular structure
definition: Acellular anatomical structure whose predominant constituent is keratin.

name: epithelial sac
definition: An epithelial tube that is open at one end only.

name: epithelial tube open at both ends
definition: An epithelial tube open at both ends that allows fluid flow.

name: arborizing epithelial duct system
definition: A collection of connected epithelial tubes with a single portal.

name: epithelial vesicle
definition: A closed epithelium with a lumen.

name: smooth muscle sphincter
definition: A ring of smooth muscle cells whose contraction closes the opening of the ring.

name: striated muscle sphincter
definition: A ring of striated muscle cells whose contraction closes the opening of the ring.

name: dense mesenchyme tissue
definition: Mesenchyme with little extracellular matrix.

name: loose mesenchyme tissue
definition: Mesenchyme whose cells are embedded in obvious amounts of extracellular matrix.

name: migrating mesenchyme population
definition: Mesenchymal cells that are migrating.

name: regenerating anatomical structure
definition: An anatomical structure that is undergoing regeneration.

name: ciliated columnar oviduct epithelium
definition: A ciliated columnar epithelium that is part of a oviduct.

name: cuboidal oviduct epithelium
definition: A cuboidal epithelium that is part of a oviduct.

name: ciliated columnar epithelium
definition: Simple columnar epithelium in which the luminal side of the cells bears cilia. Examples: epithelium of trachea, epithelium of uterine tube.[FMA].

name: ciliated epithelium
definition: Epithelium bearing vibratile cilia on the free surface.

name: stratified columnar epithelium
definition: Stratified columnar epithelia is a rare type of epithelial tissue composed of column shaped cells arranged in multiple layers. Stratified columnar epithelia are found in the ocular conjunctiva of the eye, in parts of the pharynx and anus, the female's uterus, the male urethra and vas deferens. Also found in intralobular ducts in salivary glands.[WP].

name: layer of synovial tissue
definition: A thin, loose vascular connective tissue that makes up the membranes surrounding joints and the sheaths protecting tendons (particularly flexor tendons in the hands and feet) where they pass over bony prominences. Synovial tissue contains synovial cells, which secrete a viscous liquid called synovial fluid; this liquid contains protein and hyaluronic acid and serves as a lubricant and nutrient for the joint cartilage surfaces[BTO]. Synovial tissue can be found in tendons (tissues that connect muscle to bone), bursae (fluid-filled, cushioning sacs found in spaces between tendons, ligaments, and bones), and the cavity (hollow enclosed area) that separates the bones of a freely movable joint, such as the knee or elbow[BTO].

name: synovial cavity of joint
definition: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a synovial joint.

name: pigment epithelium of eye
definition: Epithelial layer of the retina, ciliary body, or iris composed of cells containing pigment granules.

name: lateral septal complex
definition: The lateral septal area; largest nuclear mass in this region, plays a pivotal role in various physiological processes, such as aggression, emotion, thermoregulation, water and food intake and sexual behaviour.

name: medial septal complex
definition: A septal nuclear complex that consists of the nucleus of the diagonal bands and the septal medial nuclei.

name: nucleus of medulla oblongata
definition: A neural nucleus that is part of a medulla oblongata.

name: hippocampus stratum lucidum
definition: Layer of hippocampus area CA3 lying superficial to the pyramidal cell layer that contains mossy fiber axons projecting from the dentate gyrus. A slight thickening in this layer marks the border in some species between areas CA2 and CA3. dapted from Paxinos, G. The rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, Academic Press, San Diego, 1995, pg. 460).

name: hippocampus alveus
definition: Regional part of fornix consisting of a thin layer of white matter on the surface of the hippocampal formation, bordering the wall of the lateral ventricle and composed of white, myelinated fibers. The alveus arises from cell bodies in the subiculum and hippocampus, and eventually merges with the fimbria of the hippocampus. The fimbria goes on to become the fornix (MM: 2006-10-26).

name: trigeminal nuclear complex
definition: The sensory trigeminal nerve nuclei are the largest of the cranial nerve nuclei, and extend through the whole of the midbrain, pons and medulla. There is also a distinct trigeminal motor nucleus that is medial to the chief sensory nucleus[WP].

name: thoracic lymph node
definition: A lymph node that is part of a thorax. Includes lymph nodes of the lungs and mediastinal lymph nodes.

name: future meninx
definition: A developing mesenchymal capsule that covers the developing brain and spinal cord and is the precursor of the meningeal cluster. In mammals this gives rise to the arachnoid mater, pia mater and dura mater. In cyclostomes and fishes, the future meninx gives rise to a single meningeal layer, the primitive meninx.

name: endomeninx
definition: The innermost layer of the mesenchymal capsule that surrounds the developing brain, primarily of neural crest origin. The endomeninx forms the leptomeninx.

name: ectomeninx
definition: The outermost layer of the mesenchymal capsule that surrounds the developing brain, of mixed paraxial mesoderm and neural crest origin. The ectomeninx forms the dura mater (both inner layer and outer chondrogenic layer).

name: anatomical junction
definition: An anatomical structure that connects two structures.

name: esophageal sphincter
definition: A sphincter that is part of an esophagus.

name: uriniferous tubule
definition: Functional unit of the kidney that forms urine, consisting of two parts, the nephron and the collecting tubule.

name: kidney field
definition: Region of the embryo into the area in which the kidney rudiment will develop.

name: anlage
definition: Anlagen are populations of contiguous cells, typically arranged in one plane, that are morphologically indistinct, but that already correspond in extent to a later organ/tissue.

name: thyroid diverticulum
definition: Endodermal bud derived from the endodermal epithelium of the embryonic pharyngeal floor[MP]. The thyroid diverticulum is the embryological structure from which thyroid follicular cells derive. It grows from the floor of the pharnyx[WP].

name: early pharyngeal endoderm
definition: relation conflict: ZFA vs EHDAA2. Note EHDAA2 term renamed to 'early PA endoderm'

name: gustatory pore
definition: The minute opening of a taste bud on the surface of the oral mucosa through which the gustatory hairs of the specialised neuroepithelial gustatory cells project.

name: nucleus of thalamus
definition: A nucleus of brain that is part of a thalamus.

name: tract of spinal cord
definition: An axon tract that is part of a spinal cord.

name: tract of brain
definition: An axon tract that is part of a brain.

name: bone of reproductive organ
definition: A bone that is part of a reproductive organ.

name: interphalangeal joint of pes
definition: The interphalangeal articulations of the foot (articulations of the phalanges) are ginglymoid joints, and each has a plantar and two collateral ligaments. The arrangement of these ligaments is similar to that in the metatarsophalangeal articulations: the Extensor tendons supply the places of dorsal ligaments.

name: interphalangeal joint of manus
definition: The interphalangeal articulations of hand are hinge-joints of the phalanges of the hand. There are two sets (except in the thumb): 'proximal interphalangeal joints' (PIP), those between the first (also called proximal) and second (intermediate) phalanges 'distal interphalangeal joints' (DIP), those between the second and third (distal) phalanges A similar group of articulations also function in the toes.

name: epidermis gland
definition: A gland that is part of a epidermis.

name: umbilical vein endothelium
definition: An endothelium that is part of a umbilical vein.

name: umbilical artery endothelium
definition: An endothelium that is part of a umbilical artery.

name: transudate
definition: Any bodily fluid that has passed through a membrane such as the capillary wall, as a result of unbalanced hydrostatic and osmotic forces.

name: secretion of serous gland
definition: Any fluid produced by a serous gland.

name: vascular system
definition: Anatomical system that consists of all blood and lymph vessels.

name: connecting stalk
definition: A bridge of mesoderm connecting the caudal end of the young embryo with the trophoblastic tissues; the precursor of the umbilical cord.

name: connecting stalk vasculature
definition: A vasculature that is part of a connecting stalk.

name: adipose tissue of abdominal region
definition: Adipose tissue that is located in the abdominal region. This includes any subcutaneous fat, visceral fat or encapsulated adipose tissue depots.

name: craniocervical region
definition: The anteriormost subdivision of the body that includes the head, jaws, pharyngeal region and the neck (if present). In vertebrates this is the subdivision that includes the cervical vertebrae.

name: post-anal tail
definition: A tail that extends from the posterior tip of the organism to the anus, contains muscle and skeleton.

name: appendage girdle region
definition: An organism subdivision that encompasses the region containing the pectoral or pelvic girdle. Note that this includes both the skeletal elements and associated tissues (integument, muscle, etc).

name: peritoneal mesentery
definition: Mesentery that is located in the peritoneum.

name: external nose
definition: External part of the nose containing the external nares.

name: girdle bone/zone
definition: A bone that is part of a appendage girdle region.

name: pectoral girdle bone
definition: A bone that is part of a pectoral girdle region.

name: pelvic girdle bone/zone
definition: A bone element or fused bone that is part of pelvic girdle.

name: pectoral girdle skeleton
definition: A subdivision of a limb or fin skeleton consisting of bones which connects the upper limb or fin to the axial skeleton on each side. It consists of the clavicle and scapula in humans and, in those species with three bones in the pectoral girdle, the coracoid. Some mammalian species (e.g. the dog and the horse) have only the scapula. In humans, the only joints between the shoulder girdle and axial skeleton are the sternoclavicular joints on each side. No joint exists between each scapula and the rib cage; instead the muscular connection between the two permits relatively great mobility of the shoulder girdle in relation to the pelvic girdle. In those species having only the scapula, no joint exists between the forelimb and the thorax, the only attachment being muscular[WP]. Examples: There are only two instances, right and left pectoral girdle skeletons.

name: pelvic girdle skeleton
definition: Skeletal subdivision consisting of a set of bones linking the axial series to the hindlimb zeugopodium and offering anchoring areas for hindlimb and caudal musculature.

name: membrane bone
definition: Bone element that arises as a result of intramembranous ossification.

name: cartilage element
definition: Skeletal element that is composed of cartilage tissue and may be permanent or transient.

name: regular connective tissue
definition: Connective tissue, which consists of fibroblasts, the intercellular matrix of which contains a regular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: bone (tissue), cartilage (tissue), dense regular connective tissue.

name: dense regular connective tissue
definition: Connective tissue that is dominated by collagen fibres organized into a definitive pattern (e.g., parallel to one another), with comparatively fewer cells (mostly fibroblasts).

name: bone of craniocervical region
definition: A bone that is part of a craniocervical region.

name: sesamoid bone of manus
definition: A sesamoid bone that is part of a manus.

name: sesamoid bone of pes
definition: A sesamoid bone that is part of a pes.

name: irregular bone
definition: The irregular bones are bones which, from their peculiar form, cannot be grouped as long bone, short bone, flat bone or sesamoid bone. Irregular bones serve various purposes in the body, such as protection of nervous tissue, affording multiple anchor points for skeletal muscle attachment (as with the sacrum), and maintaining pharynx and trachea support, and tongue attachment (such as the hyoid bone). They consist of cancellous tissue enclosed within a thin layer of compact bone. The irregular bones are: the vertebrC&, sacrum, coccyx, temporal, sphenoid, ethmoid, zygomatic, maxilla, mandible, palatine, inferior nasal concha, and hyoid.

name: joint of girdle
definition: A skeletal joint that is part of a appendage girdle region.

name: surface of cartilage
definition: An anatomical surface that is part of a cartilage element.

name: pneumatized bone
definition: A bone that is hollow or contains many air cells, such as the mastoid process of the temporal bone[TMD].

name: muscle of pectoral girdle
definition: Any muscle organ that is part of a pectoral girdle region.

name: nail plate
definition: The nail plate is the hard and translucent portion of the nail, composed of keratin.

name: pelvic cavity
definition: The part of the ventral body cavity that is within the pelvis.

name: craniocervical region musculature
definition: Musculature system of the pharyngeal and head regions.

name: dorsal thoracic segment of trunk
definition: Subdivision of thorax, which in humans is the posterior part of the thorax and is demarcated from the chest by the external surface of the posterolateral part of the rib cage and the anterior surface of the thoracic vertebral column; together with the chest, it constitutes the thorax.

name: lower back muscle
definition: A muscle of back that is part of a lower back.

name: upper back muscle
definition: A muscle of back that is part of a dorsal thoracic segment of trunk.

name: right clavicle
definition: A clavicle that is in the right side of a entire appendicular skeleton.

name: left clavicle
definition: A clavicle that is in the left side of a entire appendicular skeleton.

name: periodontal ligament
definition: The fibrous connective tissue that surrounds the root of a tooth, separating it from and attaching it to the alveolar bone. It extends from the base of the gingival mucosa to the fundus of the bony socket, and its main function is to hold the tooth in its socket[BTO].

name: tooth bud
definition: A knoblike tooth primordium that develops into the mature tooth and consists of enamel organ, dental papilla, and dental sac enclosing them.

name: inner chondrogenic layer of perichondrium
definition: The perichondrium consists of two separate layers: an outer fibrous layer and inner chondrogenic layer. The chondrogenic layer remains undifferentiated and can form chondroblasts or chondrocytes.

name: outer fibrous layer of perichondrium
definition: The perichondrium consists of two separate layers: an outer fibrous layer and inner chondrogenic layer. The fibrous layer contains fibroblasts, which produce collagenous fibers.

name: heart endothelium
definition: An endothelium that is part of a heart [Automatically generated definition].

name: nasopharyngeal gland
definition: A gland that is part of a nasopharynx.

name: erectile tissue
definition: With numerous vascular spaces that may become engorged with blood.

name: clitoral smooth muscle
definition: A smooth muscle tissue that is part of a clitoris.

name: plantar part of pes
definition: The sole is the bottom of the foot.

name: intestinal villus of duodenum
definition: An intestinal villus in the duodenum.

name: intestinal villus of jejunum
definition: An intestinal villus in the jejunum.

name: intestinal villus of ileum
definition: An intestinal villus in the ileum.

name: ileal epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a ileum.

name: duodenal epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a duodenum.

name: breast epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a breast.

name: tracheobronchial epithelium
definition: Epithelium pertaining to the trachea and bronchi.

name: proximal tubular epithelium
definition: The cells lining the proximal tubule are cuboidal epithelial cells with deep basal membrane invaginations that provide a large basal surface area. The long microvilli (the brush border) lining the tubule lumen, maximize luminal surface area and make these cells ideally suited for both reabsorptive and secretory functions.

name: distal tubular epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a distal tubule.

name: mammary ridge
definition: A ridge of epidermal cells that will form the mammary placodes.

name: cervical vertebral foramen
definition: A vertebral foramen that is part of a cervical vertebra.

name: lumbar vertebral foramen
definition: A vertebral foramen that is part of a lumbar vertebra.

name: sacral foramen
definition: A vertebral foramen that is part of a sacral vertebra.

name: thoracic vertebral foramen
definition: A vertebral foramen that is part of a thoracic vertebra.

name: lumbar vertebral arch
definition: A neural arch that is part of a lumbar vertebra.

name: cervical vertebral arch
definition: A neural arch that is part of a cervical vertebra.

name: vertebral arch of sacral segment
definition: A neural arch that is part of a sacral vertebra.

name: thoracic vertebral arch
definition: A neural arch that is part of a thoracic vertebra.

name: intertarsal joint
definition: Intertarsal articulations are the joints of the tarsus. The specific intertarsal articulations are: Talocalcaneal articulation Talocalcaneonavicular articulation Calcaneocuboid articulation Cuneonavicular articulation Cuboideonavicular articulation Intercuneiform articulation Cuneocuboid articulation.

name: nasal muscle
definition: Any muscle organ that is part of an nose.

name: pectoral girdle and thoracic body wall skeletal muscle
muscle tissue of prostate
definition: A muscle tissue that is part of a prostate gland.

name: proximal epiphysis of tibia
definition: A proximal epiphysis that is part of a tibia.

name: proximal epiphysis of fibula
definition: A proximal epiphysis that is part of a fibula.

name: inner cell mass derived epiblast
definition: An embryonic structure that is derived from the inner cell mass and lies above the hypoblast and gives rise to the three primary germ layers.

name: dorsal venous arch
definition: The dorsal venous arch of the foot is a superficial vein that connects the small saphenous vein and the great saphenous vein. Anatomically, it is defined by where the dorsal veins of the first and fifth digit, respectively, meet the great saphenous vein and small saphenous vein.

name: lower limb segment
definition: A limb segment that is part of a hindlimb.

name: upper limb segment
definition: A limb segment that is part of a forelimb.

name: cranial fossa
definition: Any of the three large depressions in the posterior, middle, and anterior aspects of the floor of the cranial cavity.

name: skin of cheek
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a cheek.

name: gingival groove
definition: The gingival sulcus is an area of potential space between a tooth and the surrounding gingival tissue and is lined by sulcular epithelium. The depth of the sulcus (Latin for groove) is bounded by two entities: apically by the gingival fibers of the connective tissue attachment and coronally by the free gingival margin.

name: intromittent organ
definition: An external organ of a male organism that is specialized to deliver sperm during copulation. Intromittent organs are found most often in terrestrial species, as most aquatic species fertilize their eggs externally, although there are exceptions[WP].

name: pharyngeal arch system
definition: A transient embryonic complex that comprises the pharyngeal arches, bulges of tissues of mesoderm and neural crest derivation through which pass nerves and pharyngeal arch arteries. The arches are separated internally by pharyngeal pouches, evaginations of foregut endoderm, and externally by pharyngeal clefts, invaginations of surface ectoderm. The development of the system ends when the stucture it contributes to are forming, which may include (depending on species) the thymus, thyroid, parathyroids, maxilla, mandible, aortic arch, cardiac outflow tract, external and middle ear[GO,modified].

name: embryonic head
definition: A head that is part of a embryo.

name: thymus primordium endoderm
definition: An endoderm that is part of a thymus primordium.

name: neural tube derived brain
definition: A brain that develops_from a neural tube.

name: duct of epididymis
definition: Any duct branching of of the main epididymis duct.

name: pulmonary surfactant
definition: A substance formed by type II alveolar cells composed of surface-active lipoprotein complex (phospholipoprotein).

name: hepatic diverticulum
definition: An out-pocket of thickened ventral foregut epithelium adjacent to the developing heart. Constitutes the first morphological sign of the embryonic liver. The anterior portion of the hepatic diverticulum gives rise to the liver and intrahepatic biliary tree, while the posterior portion forms the gall bladder and extrahepatic bile ducts.

name: nonskeletal ligament
definition: A ligament that does not connect two skeletal elements.

name: skeletal ligament
definition: Dense regular connective tissue connecting two or more adjacent skeletal elements[VSAO,modified].

name: ectoplacental cavity
definition: Closed space within the ectoplacental cone, formed by the fusion of the parts of the amniotic fold that separate it from the amniotic cavity[MP]. a developmental cavity that exists in some mammals and is derived by division of the proamniotic space; it is further removed from the embryo than the amniotic cavity in some mammals.

name: stomach muscularis externa
definition: The smooth muscle layer of the stomach wall that functions to churn and mix food and gastric secretions as well as to move food along the digestive tract to the intestines.

name: stomach smooth muscle circular layer
synonyms: middle circular muscle layer of stomach
definition: The middle layer of the muscularis; it is continuous with the circular layer of the esophagus, but is absent in the fundus and lies concentric to the longitudinal axis of the stomach; the circular layer is normally tonically constricted forming a functional pyloric sphincter, which controls the movement of chyme into the duodenum.

name: pyloric canal
definition: The short narrow part of the stomach extending from the pyloric antrum to the pyloric sphincter.

name: cardiac gastric gland
definition: A gastric gland in the cardiac region of the stomach; cardiac glands are fewer in number than in the fundus and body, and secrete mucin which coats the stomach and protects it[MP].

name: pyloric gastric gland
definition: The gastric glands in the pyloric region of the stomach; the pyloric glands secrete mucin, which coats the stomach and protects it, and hormones such as gastrin and enkephalin[MP].

name: stomach smooth muscle inner oblique layer
synonyms: inner oblique muscle layer of stomach
oblique fiber layer of gastric muscularis
definition: The innermost layer of the muscularis; it is not present in all sections of the stomach but is clearly seen in the fundus and near the lesser curvature of the corpus; the oblique fibers disappear distally (towards the pyloric antrum); the oblique layer is responsible for creating the motion that churns and physically breaks down the food.

name: pulmonary alveolar parenchyma
definition: The distinguishing cell types of the lung alveolar tissue, including pulmonary epithelial cells (pneumocytes), alveolar capillary endothelial cells, interstitial cells (fibroblasts) and alveolar macrophages.

name: pulmonary acinus
definition: The largest lung subunit in which all airways participate in gas exchange, and it is composed of the parenchyma of the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, and alveoli.

name: hypodermis skeletal muscle layer
definition: Any skeletal muscle organ in the hypodermis / superficial fascia.

name: epidermal-dermal junction
definition: The multi-layer basement membrane between the dermis and epidermis that serves to adhere the dermis and epidermis, provide mechanical support for the epidermis, and forms a barrier to cells and large molecules across the junction.

name: spinal cord commissure
definition: The nerve fiber tracts that span the midline of the spinal cord.

name: osteoid
definition: Bone tissue that is an unmineralized bone matrix deposited by osteoblasts prior to the mineralization of bone tissue.

name: left putamen
definition: A putamen that is part of a left cerebral hemisphere.

name: right putamen
definition: A putamen that is part of a right cerebral hemisphere.

name: pulmonary vascular system
definition: The part of the cardiovascular system consisting of all pulmonary arteries and all pulmonary veins.

name: rectal venous plexus
definition: The hemorrhoidal plexus (or rectal venous plexus) surrounds the rectum, and communicates in front with the vesical venous plexus in the male, and the uterovaginal plexus in the female. A free communication between the portal and systemic venous systems is established through the hemorrhoidal plexus.

name: splanchnocranium
definition: Subdivision of endoskeleton derived from pharyngeal arches.

name: post-hyoid pharyngeal arch
definition: A pharyngeal arch that is posterior to the hyoid arch. i.e. any pharyngeal arch with a number 3 or higher.

name: neuromast
definition: Volcano-shaped lateral line sensory organ located in characteristic positions within the skin epithelium and containing hair cells and their support elements.

name: lateral line nerve
definition: Cranial nerves that carry afferent and efferent fibers for the lateral line system.

name: dermal bone
definition: Skeletal element that forms superficially in the organism, usually in association with the ectoderm[VSAO].

name: perichordal bone
definition: Bone element that is adjacent to the notochord.

name: substratum of layer of retina
definition: Missing definition for term UBERON:0008921. Please replace it using linked reference.

name: sublaminar layer S1
definition: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the inner nuclear layer and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

name: sublaminar layer S2
definition: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the S1 and S3 layers and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

name: sublaminar layer S3
definition: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the S2 and S4 layers and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

name: sublaminar layer S4
definition: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the S3 and S5 layer and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

name: sublaminar layer S5
definition: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the retinal ganglion cell layer and comprises 20 percent of the ganglion plexiform layer of retina.

name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2
definition: One of sublaminar layers S1 or S2.

name: sublaminar layers S2 or S3
definition: One of sublaminar layers S2 or S3.

name: sublaminar layers S4 or S5
definition: One of sublaminar layers S4 or S5.

name: lung parenchyma
definition: A parenchyma that is part of a lung.

name: left lung lobe
definition: A lobe of lung that is part of a left lung.

name: forelimb bone
definition: A bone that is part of a forelimb region. Examples: humerus, any of the phalanges. Counter-example: scapula (a bone of the pectoral girdle). Note that we consider the forelimb to end at the shoulder.

name: dental follicle
definition: A sac containing the developing tooth and its odontogenic organ. The dental follicle (DF) differentiates into the periodontal ligament. In addition, it may be the precursor of other cells of the periodontium, including osteoblasts, cementoblasts and fibroblasts. They develop into the alveolar bone, the cementum with Sharpey's fibers and the periodontal ligament fibers respectively.

name: apocrine gland
definition: Any exocrine gland whose cells bud their secretions off through the plasma membrane producing membrane-bound vesicles in the lumen; the apical portion of the secretory cell of the gland pinches off and enters the lumen; it loses part of its cytoplasm in their secretions; apocrine secretion is functional during hormonal stress or puberty; an example of true apocrine glands are mammary glands, responsible for secreting breast milk.

name: renal parenchyma
definition: The functional tissue of the kidney, consisting of the nephrons.

name: submucosal esophageal gland
synonyms: mucous gland of submucosa of esophagus
definition: One of the racemose glands in the walls of the esophagus that in humans are small and serve principally to lubricate the food but in some birds secrete a milky fluid on which the young are fed.

name: nucleus of cerebellar nuclear complex
definition: Four accumulations of gray substance embedded in the white substance of the cerebellum, comprising the nucleus dentatus, nucleus emboliformis, nucleus globosus, and nucleus fastigii.

name: vasculature of brain
definition: System pertaining to blood vessels in the brain.

name: periurethral tissue
definition: Any portion of tissue that surrounds a urethra.

name: lower back skin
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a lower back.

name: upper back skin
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a dorsal thoracic segment of trunk.

name: vesical artery
definition: An artery that supplies blood to the urinary bladder.

name: pudendal vein
definition: Either the internal or external pudendal vein, running from the genital-vulvar area and abdomen and down the leg.

name: left pulmonary vein
definition: Vein that drains left lung and returns blood to the heart.

name: right pulmonary vein
definition: Vein that drains right lung and returns blood to the heart.

name: renal straight tubule
definition: Any region of a nephron tubule that is straight. Examples: distal convoluted tubule, proximal convoluted tuble.

name: lymph node germinal center
definition: A germinal center that is located in a lymph node.

name: prostatic venous plexus
definition: The prostatic veins form a well-marked prostatic plexus which lies partly in the fascial sheath of the prostate and partly between the sheath and the prostatic capsule. It communicates with the pudendal and vesical plexuses.

name: gravid organism
definition: An organism containing a developing embryo, fetus, or unborn offspring within the body.

name: gravid uterus
definition: The uterus in pregnancy.

name: cervical thymus
definition: A mature thymus that is entirely part of the cervical region.

name: thoracic thymus
definition: A mature thymus that is entirely part of thoracic region.

name: indifferent gonad
definition: A gonad prior to differentiating into a definitive testis or ovary.

name: adenohypophyseal placode
definition: The adenohypophyseal placode forms the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland and gives rise to the endocrine secretory cells of the pituitary.

name: geniculate placode
definition: Rostralmost epibranchial placode. Associated with 1st branchial cleft.

name: petrosal placode
definition: Epibranchial placode between geniculate and nodose. Associated with 2nd branchial cleft.

name: nodosal placode
definition: Caudalmost epibranchial placode. Associated with 3rd branchial cleft.

name: epibranchial ganglion
definition: Cranial ganglion which develops from an epibranchial placode.

name: lateral line placode
definition: An ectodermal placode that will develop into the components of the lateral line system.

name: right atrium endocardium
definition: Endocardium that is part of the right atrium.

name: pleuroperitoneal membrane
definition: A fold of tissue which extends into the peritoneal cavity of the developing embryo and participates in the separation of the pleural and peritoneal cavities.

name: craniocervical region vein
definition: A vein that is part of a craniocervical region.

name: entire embryonic mesenchyme
definition: Sum total of mesenchyme in the embryo.

name: sphenoid bone pre-cartilage condensation
definition: A sphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

name: sphenoid cartilage element
definition: A sphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

name: craniofacial suture
definition: Any suture between cranial and/or facial bones.

name: facial suture
definition: Any suture between facial bones.

name: limb epidermis
definition: The limb epidermis is the outer epithelial layer of the limb, it is a complex stratified squamous epithelium.

name: nephric duct
definition: A nephric duct is a tube that drains a primitive kidney[GO].

name: medial nasal process mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a medial nasal prominence.

name: lateral nasal process mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a lateral nasal prominence.

name: lateral nasal process surface ectoderm
definition: An ectoderm that is part of a lateral nasal prominence.

name: pharyngeal membrane
definition: A thin fold of ectoderm and endoderm that separates the pharyngeal pouches from the pharyngeal clefts in a developing embryo.

name: pharyngeal membrane of 1st arch
definition: A pharyngeal membrane that separates the first pharyngeal cleft from the first pharyngeal pouch.

name: cartilaginous vertebral centrum
definition: Cartilaginous form of a vertebral centrum, a skeletal element that functionally replaces the notochord[VSAP,modified].

name: dorsum of tongue
definition: The superior surface of the tongue divided by the sulcus terminalis into an anterior two-thirds, the presulcal part (pars presulcalis). and a posterior one-third, the postsulcal part (pars postsulcalis).

name: axilla
definition: The axilla is the area directly under the joint where the forelimb connects to the shoulder.

name: associated mesenchyme of otic placode
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a otic placode.

name: ectoderm of buccopharyngeal membrane
definition: An ectoderm that is part of a buccopharyngeal membrane.

name: endoderm of buccopharyngeal membrane
definition: An endoderm that is part of a buccopharyngeal membrane.

name: associated mesenchyme of foregut-midgut junction
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

name: mesentery of foregut-midgut junction
definition: A mesentery that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

name: pharyngeal arch mesenchymal region
definition: A portion of mesenchymal tissue associated with an individual pharyngeal arch.

name: epithelium of foregut-midgut junction
definition: An epithelium that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

name: periotic mesenchyme
definition: Anatomical region that surrounds the otic vesicle.

name: mesenchyme of fronto-nasal process
definition: The embryonic connective tissue made up of loosely aggregated mesenchymal cells, supported by interlaminar jelly, that gives rise to the frontonasal region of the head.

name: mesenchyme of hindgut
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing hindgut.

name: mesenchyme of trachea
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing trachea.

name: mesenchyme of middle ear
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing middle ear.

name: anal membrane endodermal component
definition: An endoderm that is part of a anal region.

name: lateral lingual swelling epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a lateral lingual swelling.

name: mesenchyme of handplate
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a handplate.

name: maxillary process mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a maxillary prominence.

name: vascular element of left lung
definition: A vascular plexus that is part of a left lung.

name: vascular element of right lung
definition: A vascular plexus that is part of a right lung.

name: mesenchyme of sublingual gland primordium
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a sublingual gland primordium.

name: mesenchyme of submandibular gland primordium
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a submandibular gland primordium.

name: hepatic sinusoid of left of lobe of liver
definition: A hepatic sinusoid that is part of a left lobe of liver.

name: hepatic sinusoid of right of lobe of liver
definition: A hepatic sinusoid that is part of a right lobe of liver.

name: endoderm of foregut-midgut junction
definition: An endoderm that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

name: distal segment of digit
definition: A segment of a digit containing the distal phalanx, and overlapping the distal interphalangeal joint[CJM]. The digit tip is derived from multiple and distinct embryonic origins, and includes the distal bone with associated marrow cavity and haematopoietic cells, ventral (flexor) and dorsal (extensor) tendons, sweat glands with myoepithelial and luminal secreting cells and associated neurons for innervation, dermis with resident melanocytes and dendritic cells, mesenchyme with resident fibroblasts, skin epidermis with hair follicles, a nail organ composed of six specific parts (the root, nail bed, nail plate, eponychium (cuticle), perionychium and hyponychium).

name: distal segment of manual digit
definition: A segment of the manual digit containing the distal phalanx.

name: distal segment of pedal digit
definition: A segment of the pedal digit containing the distal phalanx. Note this class represents a digit segment and thus includes tissues in addition to bone.

name: metacarpal/tarsal-phalangeal joint
definition: A skeletal joint that connects a mesopodium bone and connects a proximal phalanx.

name: distal limb integumentary appendage
definition: A nail, hoof or claw.

name: nail of manual digit
definition: A nail that is part of a manual digit.

name: intestinal submucosa
definition: A submucosa that is part of a intestine.

name: nail of pedal digit
definition: A nail that is part of a pedal digit.

name: trunk region of vertebral column
definition: Subdivision of vertebral column that corresponds to the trunk of the body, containing the trunk/presacral vertebrae. In organisms that have a thoracic and lumbar distinction, this corresponds to the sum of both of these regions.

name: spinal cord sulcus limitans
synonyms: spinal cord lateral wall sulcus limitans
definition: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future spinal cord.

name: ventral midline
definition: In protostomes (such as insects, snails and worms) as well as deuterostomes (vertebrates), the midline is an embryonic region that functions in patterning of the adjacent nervous tissue. The ventral midline in insects is a cell population extending along the ventral surface of the embryo and is the region from which cells detach to form the ventrally located nerve cords. In vertebrates, the midline is originally located dorsally. During development, it folds inwards and becomes the ventral part of the dorsally located neural tube and is then called the ventral midline, or floor plate.

name: lumen of central canal of spinal cord
synonyms: cavity of central canal of spinal cord
definition: A cerebrospinal fluid-filled space that runs longitudinally through the length of the entire spinal cord. The central canal is contiguous with the ventricular system of the brain. The central canal represents the adult remainder of the neural tube.

name: medulla oblongata sulcus limitans
definition: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future medulla oblongata.

name: metencephalon sulcus limitans
definition: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future metencephalon.

name: myelencephalon sulcus limitans
definition: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future myelencephalon.

name: spinal cord mantle layer
synonyms: mantle layer lateral wall spinal cord
spinal cord lateral wall mantle layer

name: 1st arch mandibular mesenchyme
synonyms: mesenchymal region of mandibular component of first pharyngeal arch
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a 1st arch mandibular component.

name: left lung associated mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing left lung.

name: right lung associated mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing right lung.

name: forebrain neural plate
definition: A neural plate that develops_from a future forebrain.

name: midbrain neural plate
definition: A neural plate that develops_from a presumptive midbrain.

name: hindbrain neural plate
definition: A neural plate that develops_from a presumptive hindbrain.

name: presumptive midbrain
definition: A presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a midbrain.

name: head paraxial mesoderm
definition: Bilateral mesenchymal mesoderm parallel and immediately adjacent to the neural tube/notochord; it generates a subset of extra-ocular, and other head, muscles.

name: tail somite
definition: A somite that is part of a tail.

name: pronephric proximal straight tubule
definition: A proximal straight tubule that is part of a pronephros.

name: spinal nerve root
definition: The paired bundles of nerve fibers entering and leaving the spinal cord at each segment. The dorsal and ventral nerve roots join to form the mixed segmental spinal nerves. The dorsal roots are generally afferent, formed by the central projections of the spinal (dorsal root) ganglia sensory cells, and the ventral roots efferent, comprising the axons of spinal motor and autonomic preganglionic neurons. There are, however, some exceptions to this afferent/efferent rule.

name: lumbar nerve
definition: The lumbar nerves are the five spinal nerves emerging from the lumbar vertebrae. They are divided into posterior and anterior divisions.

name: sacral nerve
definition: The five sacral nerves emerge from the sacrum. Although the vertebral components of the sacrum are fused into a single bone, the sacral vertebrae are still used to number the sacral nerves. Posteriorly, they emerge from the posterior sacral foramina, and form the posterior branches of sacral nerves. Anteriorly, they emerge from the anterior sacral foramina, and contribute to the sacral plexus (S1-S4) and coccygeal plexus.

name: root of thoracic nerve
synonyms: nerve root part of thoracic spinal cord
definition: A spinal nerve root that is part of a thoracic nerve.

name: root of lumbar spinal nerve
synonyms: nerve root part of lumbar spinal cord
definition: A spinal nerve root that is part of a lumbar nerve.

name: root of cervical nerve
synonyms: nerve root part of cervical spinal cord

name: root of sacral nerve
synonyms: nerve root part of sacral spinal cord
definition: A spinal nerve root that is part of a sacral nerve.

name: orbitosphenoid ossification center
definition: merge with sphenoid lesser wing cartilage element?

name: lumbar sympathetic nerve trunk
definition: A sympathetic nerve trunk that is part of a lower back.

name: tympanic membrane epithelium
definition: One of the two epithelia which make up the tympanic membrane (along with the fibrous layer).

name: eyelid subcutaneous connective tissue
definition: An eyelid connective tissue that is part of a hypodermis.

name: nephron tubule basement membrane
definition: A basement membrane that is part of a nephron tubule.

name: bronchus basement membrane
definition: A basement membrane that is part of a bronchus.

name: trachea basement membrane
definition: A basement membrane that is part of a trachea.

name: auricular artery
definition: An artery that supplies oxygenated blood to the ear.

name: midbrain nucleus
definition: Nucleus located in the midbrain.

name: hindbrain nucleus
definition: Nucleus located within the hindbrain.

name: telencephalic nucleus
definition: A nucleus of brain that is part of a telencephalon.

name: ventral mesentery
definition: Ventral mesentery is the part of the peritoneum closest to the navel.

name: embryonic cloacal lumen
definition: An anatomical space that surrounded_by a embryonic cloaca.

name: rectal lumen
definition: An anatomical space that surrounded_by a rectum.

name: tooth row
definition: Anatomical cluster consisting of adjacent teeth constituting a row.

name: set of lower jaw teeth
definition: A tooth row that is part of a skeleton of lower jaw.

name: set of upper jaw teeth
definition: A tooth row that is part of a skeleton of upper jaw.

name: lumen of pharyngotympanic tube
definition: An organ cavity that is part of a pharyngotympanic tube.

name: epithelium of appendix
definition: An epithelium that is part of a vermiform appendix.

name: endocardium of right ventricle
definition: Any endocardium that is part of the right ventricle of the heart.

name: endocardium of left ventricle
definition: Any endocardium that is part of the left ventricle of the heart.

name: intermaxillary process
definition: The primordial mass of tissue formed by the merging of the medial nasal prominences of the embryo; it contributes to the intermaxillary portion of the upper jaw, the prolabial portion of the upper lip, and the primary palate.

name: stomodeal lumen
definition: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a stomodeum.

name: sublaminar layers S3 or S4
definition: One of sublaminar layers S3 or S4.

name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2 or S5
definition: One of sublaminar layers S1, S2, or S5.

name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2 or S3
definition: One of sublaminar layers S1, S2, or S3.

name: sublaminar layers S2 or S3 or S4
definition: One of sublaminar layers S2, S3, or S4.

name: sublaminar layers S1 or S3 or S4
definition: One of sublaminar layers S1, S3, or S4.

name: sublaminar layers S3 or S4 or S5
definition: One of sublaminar layers S3, S4, or S5.

name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2 or S3 or S4
definition: One of sublaminar layers S1, S2, S3, or S4.

name: border of sublaminar layers S1 and S2
definition: The region extending out from the boundary between layers S1 and S2.

name: border of sublaminar layers S3 and S4
definition: The region extending out from the boundary between sublaminar layers S3 and S4.

name: border between sublaminar layers
definition: A region of the retina corresponding to a portion of two adjacent substratum layers.

name: lymph node medullary sinus
definition: The channels in the lymph node medulla that separate the medullary cords and are crossed by a reticulum of cells and fibers and bounded by littoral cells; lymph flows through the medullary sinus from the cortical sinuses and into the efferent lymphatic vessels.

name: lymph node medullary cord
definition: The dense rope-like structures of lymphatic tissue located between the medullary sinuses in the medulla of a lymph node.

name: limb mesenchyme
definition: The primordial embryonic connective tissue of the developing limbs, autopods and digits, consisting of mesenchymal cells supported in interlaminar jelly, that derive mostly from the mesoderm and contribute to limb connective tissue, bone and musculature in conjunction with myotome cells.

name: cardiac mesenchyme
definition: The embryonic connective tissue made up of loosely aggregated mesenchymal cells, supported by interlaminar jelly, that gives rise to the developing cardiac structures.

name: pancreas mesenchyme
definition: The embryonic connective tissue made up of loosely aggregated mesenchymal cells, supported by interlaminar jelly, that gives rise to the developing pancreas.

name: abdominal ganglion
definition: A ganglion that is part of a abdominal segment of trunk.

name: proximal interphalangeal joint
definition: An inter-phalangeal joint that connects a proximal phalanx to either a medial or distal phalanx.

name: distal interphalangeal joint
definition: An inter-phalangeal joint that connects a distal phalanx to either a medial or proximal phalanx.

name: renal tubule
definition: A renal tubule is a tube that filters, re-absorbs and secretes substances to rid an organism of waste and to play a role in fluid homeostasis.

name: pleural sac
definition: A serous sac that has the pleura and the pleural cavity as parts.

name: upper rhombic lip
definition: Anterior-most region of dorsal hindbrain within rhombomere 1, adjacent the midbrain-hindbrain boundary.

name: glandular acinus
definition: The many-lobed berry cluster of cells that is the terminous of a gland where the secretion is produced is acinar in form.

name: prostate epithelial cord
definition: A solid cord of prostate epithelium.

name: urogenital sinus lumen
definition: An anatomical space that surrounded_by a primitive urogenital sinus.

name: urogenital sinus mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that surrounds primitive urogenital sinus.

name: embryonic cloacal epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a embryonic cloaca.

name: prostate field
definition: A specific region of the urogenital sinus epithelium into the area in which the prostate gland will develop.

name: zona limitans intrathalamica
definition: A narrow stripe of cells that lies between the prospective dorsal and ventral thalami. This boundary contains signals that pattern the prethalamic and thalamic territories of the future mid-diencephalon.

name: border of sublaminar layers S4 and S5
definition: The intersection of sublaminar layers S4 and S5.

name: border of sublaminar layers S2 and S3
definition: The intersection of sublaminar layers S2 and S3.

name: digestive tract diverticulum
definition: Branch or outpocketing of the digestive tract.

name: endosteum
definition: A thin layer of connective tissue that lines the surface of the bony tissue that forms the medullary cavity of long bones.

name: zone of stomach
definition: A division of the stomach. The stomach can be divided based on mucosal histology (glandular epithelium and gastric glands) and the relative position and type of gastric gland.

name: nephrogenic zone
definition: Outer portion of the renal cortex. Site of formation of medullary and cortical elements.

name: metapodium region
synonyms: metacarpal or metatarsal part of limb
definition: Intermediate segment of the autopod, between the mesopodial region and and acropodial region. Examples: metacarpal region, metatarsal region.

name: mesopodial skeleton
definition: The collection of all skeletal elements in a mesopodium. Examples: the tarsal skeleton, the carpal skeleton.

name: tarsal skeleton
definition: Subdivision of skeleton that consists of endochondral elements distal to the zeugopodial skeletal elements which constitute the proximal region of the posterior autopod skeleton[PHENOSCAPE:ad].

name: carpal skeleton
definition: Subdivision of skeleton that consists of the endochondral elements distal to the anterior limb/fin zeugopodial skeletal elements which constitute the proximal region of the anterior autopod skeleton[PHENOSCAPE:ad].

name: anal column
definition: One of a number of vertical folds, produced by an infolding of the mucous membrane and some of the muscular tissue in the upper half of the lumen of the anal canal[WP].

name: medullary ray
definition: A renal, cortical lobule, consisting of the ascending or descending limbs of the loop of Henle or of the collecting tubules; medullary rays are regions where parallel arrays of straight tubules travel perpendicular to the capsule and extend from the cortex to the medulla.

name: interlobar artery
synonyms: set of interlobar arteries of kidney
definition: An artery that supplies a renal lobe.

name: interlobar vein
synonyms: set of interlobar veins of kidney
definition: The interlobar veins are veins of the renal circulation which drain the renal lobes.

name: secondary heart field
definition: A specific region of the lateral mesoderm that will form the majority of the mesodermal component of the right ventricle, arterial pole (outflow tract) and venous pole (inflow tract).

name: facial mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing face.

name: root of optic nerve
definition: A nerve root that extends_fibers_into a nerve connecting eye with brain.

name: anatomical lobe
definition: A portion of an organ, such as the liver, lung, breast, or brain.

name: renal lobe
definition: The portion of a kidney consisting of a renal medullary pyramid and the renal cortex above it[MP]. It is composed of many renal lobules[WP].

name: renal lobule
definition: The portion of a renal lobe consisting of nephrons grouped around a single medullary ray and draining into a single collecting duct; human kidneys have multilobular, multipapillary architecture while mice and rats have unilobular, unipapillary kidneys.

name: wall of ureter
definition: An anatomical wall that is part of a ureter.

name: kidney corticomedullary boundary
definition: The region demarcating the renal medulla from the surrounding cortex; end-stage renal failure may be associated with loss of the normal corticomedullary boundary.

name: retrotrapezoid nucleus
definition: The loose collection of neurons that reside in the rostral medulla close to the medullary surface, ventral and immediately caudal of nVII, that are crucial for CO2 sensing in the brain.

name: ureter smooth muscle
definition: The smooth muscle tissue surrounding the epithelium of the ureter.

name: main olfactory bulb
definition: The main olfactory bulb has a multi-layered cellular architecture. In order from surface to the center the layers are: Glomerular layer, External plexiform layer, Mitral cell layer, Internal plexiform layer, Granule cell layer[WP].

name: post-embryonic organism
definition: A multicellular organism that existence_starts_with a post-embryonic stage.

name: vomeronasal system
definition: A vertebrate nasal chemosensory system that is responsible for detecting intraspecific pheromonal cues as well as environmental odorants.

name: neurogenic placode
definition: Cranial ectodermal placode with potential to develop into a component of the nervous system, such as nerves or ganglia.

name: bladder lumen
definition: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a urinary bladder.

name: esophagus smooth muscle circular layer
synonyms: inner circular muscle layer of esophagus
definition: A circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a esophagus.

name: internodal tract
definition: A conducting pathway in the conducting tissue of heart through which electrical activity spreads from the SA node to the AV node.

name: spleen venous sinus
synonyms: venous sinus of red pulp of spleen

name: epithelium of pancreatic duct
definition: An epithelium that is part of a pancreatic duct.

name: principal gastric gland
synonyms: principal gland of fundus of stomach
definition: One of the gastric glands that secretes the hydrochloric acid of the gastric juice[Stedman's].

name: ureteropelvic junction
definition: The junction between the ureter and the renal pelvis of the kidney.

name: ureterovesical junction
definition: The valve-like structure found at the site of entry of the ureter into the urinary bladder, normally displays an oblique angulation through the detrusor to avoid reflux of urine up the ureters and the kidney.

name: lumen of Rathke's pouch
definition: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a Rathke's pouch.

name: multicellular anatomical structure
definition: An anatomical structure that has more than one cell as a part.

name: cell cluster organ
definition: A small cluster of cells of various types which form a discrete structure, largely delimited by a morphological boundary and whose components work together to make the whole structure capable of a specific function.

name: placental labyrinth villous
definition: The vascularized and branched structures arising from the rodent trophoblast-derived epithelium that allow an increase its surface area for the efficient exchange of nutrients and wastes between the maternal and fetal circulation.

name: aggregate regional part of brain
definition: A regional part of brain consisting of multiple brain regions that are not related through a simple volummetric part of hierarchy, e.g., basal ganglia[NIF].

name: collection of basal ganglia
definition: Subcortical masses of gray matter in the forebrain and midbrain that are richly interconnected and so viewed as a functional system. The nuclei usually included are the caudate nucleus (caudoputamen in rodents), putamen, globus pallidus, substantia nigra (pars compacta and pars reticulata) and the subthalamic nucleus. Some also include the nucleus accumbens and ventral pallidum.

name: tubotympanic recess epithelium
definition: The dorsal portion of the embryonic first endodermal pharyngeal pouch; it develops into the middle ear cavity.

name: dorsal part of pharyngeal pouch 3
synonyms: cranial dorsal aspect of third dorsal pharyngeal pouch

name: ventral part of pharyngeal pouch 3
synonyms: caudal ventral aspect of third dorsal pharyngeal pouch

name: 6th arch mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a pharyngeal arch 6.

name: anterior part of tongue
synonyms: anterior two thirds of the tongue
definition: The portion of the tongue in front of the terminal sulcus. At the apex, thin and narrow, it is directed forward against the lingual surfaces of the lower incisor teeth. It is derived primarily from the first pharyngeal arch.

name: fundic gastric gland
synonyms: gastric gland of fundus of stomach
definition: The fundus glands (or fundic glands, or gastric glands) are found in the body and fundus of the stomach. They are simple tubes, two or more of which open into a single duct.

name: food storage organ
definition: An organ of the digestive tract that is capable of retaining and storing food.

name: 1st arch mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a pharyngeal arch 1.

name: 1st arch maxillary mesenchyme
definition: Mesenchyme that is part of a 1st arch maxillary component.

name: entire pharyngeal arch associated mesenchyme
definition: The sum total of mesenchymal tissue in the pharyngeal arch region. Pharyngeal mesenchyme is undifferentiated, loose connective tissue derived mostly from mesoderm, and also contains ectodermally derived neural crest cells.

name: oral gland
definition: Gland of the epithelium lining the oral cavity. The most common are the salivary glands.

name: mucosa of dorsum of tongue
synonyms: mucosa of dorsal surface of tongue
definition: A mucosa that is part of a dorsum of tongue.

name: future tongue
definition: A compound organ that has the potential to develop into a tongue.

name: pharyngeal opening of pharyngotympanic tube
definition: On the lateral wall of the nasal part of the pharynx is the pharyngeal opening of auditory tube (pharyngeal ostium), somewhat triangular in shape, and bounded behind by a firm prominence, the torus or cushion, caused by the medial end of the cartilage of the tube which elevates the mucous membrane.

name: open anatomical space
definition: An anatomical space with at least one opening to another space or the exterior.

name: outer epithelial layer of tympanic membrane
synonyms: outer cuticular layer of tympanic membrane
tympanic membrane external acoustic meatus epithelial component
definition: A portion of the external acoustic meatus epithelium which makes up the outer (cuticular) layer of the tympanic membrane.

name: intermediate layer of tympanic membrane
synonyms: connective tissue layer of tympanic membrane
intermediate fibrous layer of tympanic membrane
definition: The intermediate fibrous layer of the tympanic membrane.

name: chromaffin system
definition: Organ system subdivision that consists primarily of chromaffin cells and their supporting structures.

name: sacral neural crest
definition: One of the 5 distinct and partially overlapping functional domains of the premigratory neural crest. The vagal and sacral neural crest cells develop into the ganglia of the enteric nervous system, also known as the parasympathetic ganglia.

name: cuboidal epithelium
definition: An epithelium consisting of cuboidal epithelial cells.

name: future common hepatic duct
definition: An extrahepatic bile duct that has the potential to develop into a common hepatic duct.

name: future dermis
definition: Mesenchyme that has the potential to develop into a dermis.

name: future diaphragm
definition: A structure that will develop into a diaphragm.

name: future hindbrain meninx
definition: A multi-tissue structure that has the potential to develop into a meninx of hindbrain.

name: future metencephalon
definition: A developing anatomical structure that has the potential to develop into a metencephalon.

name: future myelencephalon
definition: A developing anatomical structure that has the potential to develop into a myelencephalon.

name: future facial nucleus
definition: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a facial nucleus.

name: future superior salivatory nucleus
definition: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a superior salivatory nucleus.

name: future pterygopalatine ganglion
definition: A ganglion that has the potential to develop into a pterygopalatine ganglion.

name: femur cartilage element
definition: A femur endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

name: embryonic autopod plate
definition: The distal elements of the developing limb of vertebrates that will give rise to the autopod (e.g. manus, pes, paw).

name: conducting tissue of heart
definition: Any portion of cardiac muscle tissue that is part of the conducting system of heart or the Purkinje fibers.

name: neuroendocrine gland
definition: Any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and that release hormones in response to neural stimuli.

name: secretory circumventricular organ
definition: A circumventricular organ that is capable of secreting substances into the cerebrospinal fluid.

name: sensory circumventricular organ
definition: A circumventricular organ that is capable of monitoring the levels of substances to the cerebrospinal fluid.

name: epithelial sheet
definition: An epithelial sheet is a flat surface consisting of closely packed epithelial cells.

name: primitive sex cord of indifferent gonad
definition: A sex cord that is part of a indifferent gonad.

name: seminal vesicle fluid
definition: A bodily secretion that is produced by a seminal vesicle.

name: male accessory sex gland
definition: Any gland, other than the gonad, associated with the genital tract, such as the ampulla of the ductus deferens and the bulbourethral, prostate and vesicular glands of the male.

name: skin mucus
definition: A mucous secretion that is produced by glands in the epidermis.

name: sphenofrontal suture
definition: The Sphenofrontal suture is the cranial suture between the sphenoid bone and the frontal bone.

name: lumen of lymphatic vessel
definition: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a lymphatic vessel.

name: lumen of blood vessel
definition: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a blood vessel.

name: post-anal tail tip
definition: The distal end of the tail.

name: collection of hairs
definition: An anatomical cluster that composed_primarily_of a strand of hair.

name: collection of hair on face
definition: A collection of hairs that is part of a face.

name: strand of hair of face
definition: A strand of hair that is part of a face.

name: liver trabecula
definition: A trabecula that is part of a liver.

name: male urethral gland
definition: Any of the numerous small mucous-secreting glands located in the wall of the penile urethra.

name: female urethral gland
definition: An urethral gland that is part of a female urethra.

name: ossification center
definition: The first step in ossification of the cartilage is that the cartilage cells, at the point where ossification is commencing and which is termed a ossification center, enlarge and arrange themselves in rows. The matrix in which they are imbedded increases in quantity, so that the cells become further separated from each other. A deposit of calcareous material now takes place in this matrix, between the rows of cells, so that they become separated from each other by longitudinal columns of calcified matrix, presenting a granular and opaque appearance. Here and there the matrix between two cells of the same row also becomes calcified, and transverse bars of calcified substance stretch across from one calcareous column to another. Thus there are longitudinal groups of the cartilage cells enclosed in oblong cavities, the walls of which are formed of calcified matrix which cuts off all nutrition from the cells; the cells, in consequence, atrophy, leaving spaces called the primary areolC&.

name: metacarpus skeleton
definition: The metacarpus is the intermediate part of the manus skeleton that is located between the phalanges (bones of the fingers) distally and the carpus which forms the connection to the forearm. The metacarpus consists of metacarpal bones. The metacarpals form a transverse arch to which the rigid row of distal carpal bones are fixed. The peripheral metacarpals (those of the thumb and little finger) form the sides of the cup of the palmar gutter and as they are brought together they deepen this concavity. The index metacarpal is the most firmly fixed, while the thumb metacarpal articulates with the trapezium and acts independently from the others. The middle metacarpals are tightly united to the carpus by intrinsic interlocking bone elements at their bases. The ring metacarpal forms a transitional element of the semi-independent last metacarpal. [WP,unvetted].
