name: intermetatarsal joint
definition: A joint that connects two adjacent metatarsals.

name: nonsynovial joint
definition: Joint in which the articulating bones or cartilages are connected by ligaments or fibrocartilage without an intervening synovial cavity. Examples: sagittal suture, inferior tibiofibular syndesmosis, costochondral joint, pubic symphysis.

name: intervertebral cartilage
definition: A cartilage element that lies between two successive vertebral centra.

name: ligament of vertebral column
definition: Ligament that joins successive centra. Important in controlling the stiffness of the vertebral column when it flexes.

name: axial skeletal system
definition: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the axial skeleton plus associated joints.

name: postcranial axial skeletal system
definition: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the postcranial axial skeleton plus associated joints.

name: synovial limb joint
synonyms: synovial joint of free limb segment
definition: Any synovial joint that is part of a (free) limb.

name: appendicular ossicle
definition: Ossicle that is part of the appendicular skeleton.

name: axial ossicle
definition: Ossicle that is part of the axial skeleton.

name: upper urinary tract
definition: Subdivision of urinary system which consists of the kidney and the ureters.

name: submucosal gland
definition: Gland of the lamina epithelialis mucosae which perforate the lamina muscularis, with their adenomeres located in the submucosal connective tissue.

name: facial skeleton
definition: Subdivision of skull that consists of the facial bones.

name: primary subdivision of skull
definition: The skull can be divided into two: the neurocranium and the facial skeleton.

name: primary subdivision of cranial skeletal system
neurocranium bone
definition: A bone that is part of a neurocranium [Automatically generated definition].

name: joint connecting upper and lower jaws
definition: Synovial joint that articulates bones of upper and lower jaw.

name: retrorubral area of midbrain reticular nucleus
definition: The term retrorubral area of the midbrain reticular nucleus refers to a region of the rat brain caudal and dorsal to the ventral tegmental area. It is one of three parts of the midbrain reticular nucleus; the other two are the magnocellular part of the midbrain reticular nucleus and the parvicellular part of the midbrain reticular nucleus (Swanson-2004). BrainInfo distinguishes between the Retrorubral area of the midbrain reticular formation and the retrorubral nucleus.

name: epithelium of crypt of Lieberkuhn
definition: An epithelium that is part of a crypt of Lieberkuhn.

name: gastrointestinal sphincter
definition: A sphincter muscle that is part of the gastrointestinal system.

name: lamina propria of large intestine
synonyms: lamina propria of mucosa of large intestine
definition: A lamina propria that is part of a large intestine.

name: ophthalmic vein
definition: Ophthalmic veins are veins which drain the eye. More specifically, they can refer to: Superior ophthalmic vein Inferior ophthalmic vein.

name: superior ophthalmic vein
definition: The superior ophthalmic vein begins at the inner angle of the orbit in a vein named the nasofrontal which communicates anteriorly with the angular vein; it pursues the same course as the ophthalmic artery, and receives tributaries corresponding to the branches of that vessel. Forming a short single trunk, it passes between the two heads of the Rectus lateralis and through the medial part of the superior orbital fissure, and ends in the cavernous sinus. The ethmoidal veins drain into the superior ophthalmic vein. Vorticose veins also drain into the superior ophthalmic vein.

name: parathyroid epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a parathyroid gland.

name: muscle layer of large intestine
definition: A muscle layer that is part of a large intestine.

name: muscle layer of small intestine
definition: A muscle layer that is part of a small intestine.

name: root of vagus nerve
definition: A root of cranial nerve that is part of a vagus nerve.

name: nucleus of midbrain tectum
definition: A neural nucleus that is part of a midbrain tectum.

name: central nervous system cell part cluster
definition: A multi cell part structure that is part of a central nervous system.

name: organ system subdivision
definition: A subdivision of an anatomical system.

name: synovial membrane of synovial tendon sheath
definition: Synovial sac which surrounds parts of one or more tendons. Examples: synovial tendon sheath of manual digit 2, radial bursa.

name: fibrous membrane of synovial tendon sheath
ethmoid region
definition: The most anterior region of the braincase. Provides structural support for peripheral olfactory organ.

name: appendicular skeletal system
definition: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the appendicular skeleton plus associated joints.

name: autopod bone
definition: A bone that is part of a autopod region. Note that this incudes the carpal and tarsal bones.

name: dorsal trunk
definition: The part of the trunk that is in the dorsum[cjm].

name: pharyngobasilar fascia
definition: The pharyngeal aponeurosis (or pharyngobasilar fascia, or fibrous coat), is situated between the mucous and muscular layers. It is thick above where the muscular fibers are wanting, and is firmly connected to the basilar portion of the occipital and the petrous portions of the temporal bones. As it descends it diminishes in thickness, and is gradually lost. It is strengthened posteriorly by a strong fibrous band, which is attached above to the pharyngeal spine on the under surface of the basilar portion of the occipital bone, and passes downward, forming a median raphe, which gives attachment to the Constrictores pharyngis.

name: submucosa of fallopian tube
definition: The submucous layer of the wall of the uterine tube.

name: white matter of telencephalon
synonyms: predominantly white regional part of telencephalon
definition: A partion of white matter that is part of a telencephalon. This can be further subdivided in some species, for example, into hemisphere white matter and the corpus callosum.

name: gray matter of telencephalon
synonyms: predominantly gray regional part of telencephalon
definition: A portion of gray matter that is part of a telencephalon.

name: Reissner's fiber
definition: An acellular strand that runs from subcommissural organ caudally through the ventricular system and central canal to the ampulla caudalis. Develops from glycoproteins secreted into CSF.

name: cranial blood vasculature
synonyms: set of blood vessels of head
definition: A blood vasculature that is part of a head.

name: cranial lymph vasculature
synonyms: set of lymphatic vessels of head
definition: A lymph vasculature that is part of a head.

name: transverse process of atlas
definition: A transverse process of vertebra that is part of a vertebral bone 1.

name: prepuce
definition: A retractable double-layered fold of skin and mucous membrane that covers the glans penis or clitoris. Glands may also be present.

name: skin of prepuce of clitoris
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a prepuce of clitoris.

name: lumen of esophagus
definition: An anatomical cavity that is part of a esophagus.

name: mesonephric duct lumen
definition: A tube lumen that is part of a mesonephric duct.

name: paired limb/fin skeleton
definition: The collection of all skeletal elements in an individual limb or fin.

name: stylopodial skeleton
definition: Proximal element of a free limb skeleton consisting of the femur and humerus in the forelimb stylopodium and hindlimb stylopodium respectively[VSAO, modified].

name: zeugopodial skeleton
definition: Section of the forelimb skeleton located between the stylopodium and the autopodium.

name: cell condensation
definition: Anatomical structure that is an aggregation of similar cells from which cartilages and bones form, and from which chondrogenesis and osteogenesis are initiated during repair and/or regeneration. (Hall and Miyake 1995).

name: pre-dentine
definition: Odontogenic tissue that is collagen-rich and characteristic of vertebrate teeth and tooth-like structures (e.g., odontodes) deposited by preodontoblasts and odontoblasts that are typically excluded from the matrix.

name: pre-enamel
definition: Odontogenic tissue that is avascular non-mineralized matrix that is deposited by preameloblast and ameloblasts that are excluded from the matrix.

name: non-mineralized cartilage tissue
definition: Cartilage tissue that is not mineralized.

name: commissure of diencephalon
definition: A commissure that is part of a diencephalon.

name: tract of diencephalon
definition: An axon tract that is part of a diencephalon.

name: dentary tooth
definition: Tooth that is attached to a dentary/mandible[TAO,modified].

name: jaw region
definition: A subdivision of the head that corresponds to the jaw skeleton, containing both soft tissue, skeleton and teeth (when present). The jaw region is divided into upper and lower regions.

name: bone of upper jaw
definition: Any bone that is part of the upper jaw skeleton. This includes (when present): the maxilla, the quadrate (in some species).

name: gingiva of upper jaw
definition: A gingiva that is part of a upper jaw region.

name: gingiva of lower jaw
definition: A gingiva that is part of a lower jaw region.

name: oral epithelium from ectoderm
definition: An epithelium that develops_from a ectoderm and is part of a oral epithelium.

name: iliofemoralis muscle
definition: Limb extensor that runs from ilium to femur.

name: subdivision of organism along main body axis
definition: A major subdivision of an organism that divides an organism along its main body axis (typically anterio-posterior axis). In vertebrates, this is based on the vertebral column.

name: trunk vertebra
definition: A vertebra in the trunk region. For tetrapods, includes lumbar and thoracic vertebrae. Excludes caudal/coccygeal vertebra, which are located posteriorly. In tetrapods this includes thoracic, lumbar and sacral vertebrae, and excludes the cervical vertebrae, which are located anteriorly.

name: proximal tarsal bone
definition: A tarsal bone that connected_to a hindlimb zeugopod skeleton.

name: embryonic cardiovascular system
definition: A cardiovascular system that is part of a conceptus.

name: left recurrent laryngeal nerve
synonyms: vagus X nerve left recurrent laryngeal branch

name: right recurrent laryngeal nerve
synonyms: vagus X nerve right recurrent laryngeal branch

name: cartilaginous projection
definition: Anatomical projection that is composed of cartilage tissue.

name: lower jaw opening
definition: An anatomical space that is part of a bone of lower jaw.

name: upper jaw opening
definition: An anatomical space that is part of a bone of upper jaw.

name: vagus nerve nucleus
definition: A cranial nerve nucleus that is associated with a vagus nerve.

name: nucleus of spinal cord
definition: A neural nucleus that is part of the spinal cord.

name: nerve of head region
definition: A nerve that is part of a head.

name: non-neurogenic ectodermal placode
definition: Ectodermal placode that does not develop into a component of the nervous system.

name: skin appendage placode
definition: An ectodermal placode that gives rise to any of the cutaneous appendages that protrude from the skin epidermis (heair, feathers, epidermal scales).

name: atrioventricular region
definition: An anatomical junction that divides and overlaps with and atrium and a ventricle in the heart.

name: irregular connective tissue
definition: Connective tissue, which consists of a population of connective tissue cells, the intercellular matrix of which contains an irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: areolar tissue, mucoid tissue, connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.

name: dense irregular connective tissue
definition: Irregular connective tissue is an irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a dense irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.

name: dense connective tissue
definition: Dense connective tissue is mainly composed of collagen type I. Crowded between the collagen fibers are rows of fibroblasts, fiber-forming cells, that manufacture the fibers. Dense connective tissue forms strong, rope-like structures such as tendons and ligaments. Tendons attach skeletal muscles to bones; ligaments connect bones to bones at joints. Ligaments are more stretchy and contain more elastic fibers than tendons. Dense connective tissue also make up the lower layers of the skin (dermis), where it is arranged in sheets.

name: loose connective tissue
definition: Irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a sparse irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: areolar tissue, neuroglial tissue, mucoid tissue.

name: duct of sebaceous gland
definition: A duct that is part of a sebaceous gland.

name: acinus of sebaceous gland
definition: An acinus that is part of a sebaceous gland.

name: acinus of parotid gland
definition: An acinus that is part of a parotid gland.

name: acinus of salivary gland
definition: An acinus that is part of a salivary gland.

name: acinus of lactiferous gland
definition: An acinus that is part of a mammary gland.

name: acinus of lacrimal gland
definition: An acinus that is part of a lacrimal gland.

name: acinus of exocrine gland
definition: An acinus that is part of a exocrine gland.

name: aorta collagen fibril
definition: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of aorta tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

name: pulmonary collagen fibril
definition: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of pulmonary tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

name: bone collagen fibril
definition: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of bone tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

name: tendon collagen fibril
definition: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of tendon tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

name: corneal stroma collagen fibril
definition: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of corneal stroma that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

name: ligament of sternoclavicular joint
definition: A skeletal ligament that is part of a sternoclavicular joint.

name: muscle layer of esophagus
definition: A muscle layer that is part of a wall of esophagus.

name: anterior uvea
synonyms: anterior vascular layer of the eyeball
anterior vascular tunic of the eye
definition: Front (ventral) portion of the vascular, pigmentary, or middle coat of the eye, including the ciliary body and the iris.

name: lumen of vagina
definition: An organ cavity that is part of a vagina.

name: epimysium
definition: Epimysium is a layer of connective tissue which ensheaths the entire muscle. It is composed of dense irregular connective tissue. It is continuous with fascia and other connective tissue wrappings of muscle including the endomysium, and perimysium. It is also continuous with tendons where it becomes thicker and collagenous.

name: yolk sac blood island
definition: Masses of developing blood cells attached to endothelium in the yolk sac.

name: cochlear basement membrane
definition: The the continuous basement membrane found within the membranous labyrinth of the cochlea, known to extend from the limbus, down to the inner sulcus, across the basilar membrane, up to the external sulcus to the spiral prominence and radiating into the spiral ligament ensheathing the root cell processes.

name: preganglionic autonomic fiber
definition: Nerve fibers which project from the central nervous system to autonomic ganglia. In the sympathetic division most preganglionic fibers originate with neurons in the intermediolateral column of the spinal cord, exit via ventral roots from upper thoracic through lower lumbar segments, and project to the paravertebral ganglia; there they either terminate in synapses or continue through the splanchnic nerves to the prevertebral ganglia. In the parasympathetic division the fibers originate in neurons of the brain stem and sacral spinal cord. In both divisions the principal transmitter is acetylcholine but peptide cotransmitters may also be released.

name: preganglionic sympathetic fiber
definition: A cholinergic axonal fiber projecting from the CNS to a sympathetic ganglion.

name: preganglionic parasympathetic fiber
definition: A cholinergic axonal fibers projecting from the CNS to a parasympathetic ganglion.

name: nasal hair
synonyms: hair of vestibular part of nose
definition: Hair in the nose.

name: pilosebaceous unit
definition: An epidermal invagination that has as parts a hair follicle, a sebaceous gland, and arrector pili muscle.

name: ureter luminal urothelium
definition: A luminal layer of epithelium that is part of a ureter.

name: endometrium luminal epithelium
definition: A luminal layer of epithelium that is part of a endometrium epithelium.

name: mammary gland luminal epithelium
synonyms: lumina layer of epithelium of lactiferous gland
definition: The inner cell layer of the mammary epithelium bilayer that lines the luminal surface of mammary gland ducts and alveoli; luminal cells have only limited contact with the underlying basement membrane and surrounding connective tissue; they are secretory epithelial cells characterized by the expression of the receptors for systemic hormones, i.e. estrogens, progesterone and prolactin.

name: prostate luminal epithelium
synonyms: subdivision of luminal layer of epithelium of prostatic gland
definition: A luminal layer of epithelium that is part of a prostate gland.

name: stomach glandular region
definition: A region of the stomach that is lined with glandular epithelium.

name: left hepatic vein
definition: A hepatic vein that is part of a left lobe of liver.

name: right hepatic vein
definition: A hepatic vein that is part of a right lobe of liver.

name: articular capsule of glenohumeral joint
definition: An articular capsule that is part of the glenohumeral joint.

name: saddle joint
definition: In a saddle joint (sellar joint, articulation by reciprocal reception) the opposing surfaces are reciprocally concave-convex.

name: medial ligament of ankle joint
synonyms: deltoid collateral ligament of ankle joint
medial collateral ligament of ankle joint
definition: A skeletal ligament that connects a tibia and connects a tarsal skeleton.

name: epiphysis of phalanx of pes
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a phalanx of a pes [Automatically generated definition].

name: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of pes
synonyms: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of toe
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a proximal phalanx of pes.

name: epiphysis of middle phalanx of pes
synonyms: epiphysis of middle phalanx of toe
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a middle phalanx of pes.

name: epiphysis of distal phalanx of pes
synonyms: epiphysis of distal phalanx of toe
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a distal phalanx of pes.

name: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of manus
synonyms: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of finger
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a proximal phalanx of manus.

name: epiphysis of middle phalanx of manus
synonyms: epiphysis of middle phalanx of finger
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a middle phalanx of manus.

name: epiphysis of distal phalanx of manus
synonyms: epiphysis of distal phalanx of finger
definition: An epiphysis that is part of a distal phalanx of manus.

name: crurotarsal joint
definition: A joint that connects the bones of the crus to the proximal tarsal bones.

name: coelom
definition: The aggregate of the coelemic cavity lumen plus the membranes that line the lumen.

name: myocoele
definition: The cavity within a myotome.

name: palatal tooth
definition: A tooth that is on the roof of the mouth.

name: palate bone
definition: Any bone that is part of a palate.

name: replacement bone
definition: Bone that forms as a replacement of another structural tissue.

name: patella cartilage element
definition: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a patella.

name: patella pre-cartilage condensation
definition: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a patella.

name: bronchial lumen
definition: An anatomical cavity that is part of a bronchus.

name: lumen of secondary bronchus
definition: An anatomical cavity that is part of a lobar bronchus.

name: lumen of tertiary bronchus
definition: An anatomical cavity that is part of a segmental bronchus.

name: buccal salivary gland
definition: A salivary gland that is part of a cheek.

name: digitopodium region
definition: A segment of the autopod consisting of both acropodial region and metapodial region, but excluding the mesopodial/basopodial region.

name: manual digitopodium region
definition: A digitopodium region that is part of a manus[Obol]. This includes the fingers and metacarpal region, but excludes the carpal region.

name: pedal digitopodium region
definition: A digitopodium region that is part of a pes[Obol]. This includes the toes and metatarsal region, but excludes the tarsals region.

name: skeleton of digitopodium
definition: A subdivision of the autopod skeleton consisting of both acropodial skeleon and metapodial skeleton, but excluding the mesopodial/basopodial skeleton.

name: skeleton of manual digitopodium
definition: A subdivision of the manus skeleton consisting of both manual acropodial skeleton and metacarpal skeleton, but excluding the carpal skeleton.

name: skeleton of pedal digitopodium
definition: A subdivision of the pes skeleton consisting of both pedal acropodial skeleton and metatarsal skeleton, but excluding the tarsal skeleton.

name: umbilical cord blood
definition: Blood that remains in the placenta and in the attached umbilical cord after childbirth[WP].

name: stomach primordium
definition: A primordium that has the potential to develop into a stomach.

name: skin apocrine gland
definition: An apocrine gland that is part of a skin of body.

name: head or neck skin
definition: A zone of skin that is part of a craniocervical region.

name: ovary growing follicle
definition: An ovarian follicle undergoing maturation.

name: phrenic vein
definition: The veins that run parallel to the phrenic arteries which include the two superior and two inferior phrenic veins.

name: urinary bladder vasculature
synonyms: set of urinary bladder blood vessels
definition: Network of tubes that carries blood through the distensible musculomembranous organ that serves to collect and store urine excreted by the kidneys[MP].

name: urethral meatus
definition: External opening or orifice of the urethra through which urine and seminal fluid (in males only) leave the body; in males the meatus presents as a vertical slit normally positioned at the tip of glans penis; in females the meatus is located between the clitoris and the vagina in the vulvular vestibule of the female genitalia[MP].

name: male urethral meatus
definition: A urethral meatus that is part of a male urethra[Automatically generated definition].

name: internal urethral orifice
synonyms: internal urethral orifice of urinary bladder
definition: The usually crescent-shaped opening of the urinary bladder into the urethra, placed at the anteroinferior angle (apex) of the urinary bladder trigone.

name: thyroid follicular lumen
definition: A follicular lumen is the closed cavity within a follicle of the thyroid gland. It is surrounded by follicular cells and filled with colloid, a concentrated solution of thyroglobulin.

name: cervical gland
definition: Mucus-secreting glands in the mucosa of the uterine cervix.

name: cervical mucosa
definition: Lining of the head of the uterus (cervix); contains large branched glands; does not undergo sloughing.

name: ectocervix
definition: The part of the cervix uteri that protrudes into the vagina and is lined with stratified squamous epithelium.

name: cervix glandular epithelium
definition: A glandular epithelium that is part of a uterine cervix.

name: ectocervical epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a ectocervix.

name: endocervical epithelium
definition: The glandular epithelium that lines the endocervix.

name: cervical squamo-columnar junction
definition: Region of cervical epithelium where columnar epithelium of endocervic and the stratified non-keratinising squamous epithelium of the ectocervic meet.

name: abdominal aorta artery
definition: An artery that originates from the abdominal aorta.

name: columnar epithelium
definition: An epithelium that consists of columnar epithelial cells. Columnar epithelia are epithelial cells whose heights are at least four times their width. Columnar epithelia are divided into simple (or unilayered), and the rarer stratified (or multi-layered).[WP, modified].

name: meso-epithelium
definition: Epithelium that derives from the mesoderm. [Automatically generated definition].

name: gland of nasal mucosa
definition: The nasal glands are the seromucous glands in the respiratory region of the nasal mucous membrane. The three major types of nasal glands are anterior serous glands, seromucous glands, and Bowman glands.

name: chromaffin paraganglion
definition: Small bodies containing chromaffin cells occurring outside of the adrenal medulla, most commonly near the sympathetic ganglia and in organs such as the kidney, liver, heart and gonads.

name: Rathkes pouch epithelium
definition: An epithelial sac that is part of a Rathke's pouch.

name: embryonic cloacal fold
definition: One of the pair of mesenchymal swellings (folds) located on either side of the cloacal membrane during the indifferent stage of embryonic development; cranial to the cloacal membrane the folds unite to form the genital tubercle; caudally the folds are subdivided into urogenital folds anteriorly and anal folds posteriorly.

name: mucosa of urethra
definition: A mucosa that is part of a urethra.

name: embryonic facial prominence
definition: One of five swellings formed during the development of the face.

name: vagina orifice
definition: The median slit located inferior and posterior to the external urethral orifice in the female; the exit for menstrual flow and birth and the entrance for the penis during sexual intercourse; the size and appearance of the vaginal orifice varies inversely with that of the hymen (G. membrane), a thin fold of mucous membrane that surrounds the vaginal orifice.

name: cervical artery
definition: An artery of the neck.

name: deep cervical artery
definition: The deep cervical artery (Profunda cervicalis) is an artery of the neck.

name: transverse cervical artery
synonyms: descending branch of the transverse cervical
definition: The transverse cervical artery (transverse artery of neck, transversa colli artery) is a branch of the thyrocervical trunk, running at a higher level than the suprascapular artery.

name: keratinized stratified squamous epithelium
definition: Keratinized stratified squamous epithelium is a stratified squamous epithelium, the cells of which synthesize and accumulate keratin.

name: nasal-associated lymphoid tissue
definition: The lymphocytic cell population present in the mucosa of the nasopharyngeal duct of some animals.

name: broad ligament of uterus
definition: A broad fold of peritoneum that extends from the side of the uterus to the wall of the pelvis.

name: holocrine gland
definition: Any exocrine gland whose secretion consists of its own disintegrated secretory cells along with its secretory product; holocrine secretions are produced in the cytoplasm of the cell and released by the rupture of the plasma membrane, which destroys the cell and results in the secretion of the product into the lumen.

name: acropodium region
definition: The segment of the autopod that is distal to the metapodial region and consists of the digits.

name: manual acropodium region
definition: The segment of the manus that is distal to the metacarpal region and consists of the manual digits (fingers).

name: pedal acropodium region
definition: The segment of the pes that is distal to the metatarsal region and consists of the pedal digits (toes).

name: digitopodium bone
definition: A bone that is part of a the digitopodium skeleton - i.e. the acropodial skeleton or the metapodial skeleton.

name: manual digitopodium bone
definition: A bone that is part of a the manual digitopodium skeleton - i.e. the fingers or the metacarpal skeleton.

name: pedal digitopodium bone
definition: A bone that is part of a the pedal digitopodium skeleton - i.e. the toes or the metatarsal skeleton.

name: bone of jaw
definition: A bone element that is part of a jaw region.

name: thyroid follicle epithelium
definition: An epithelium that is part of a thyroid follicle.

name: muscle layer of intestine
definition: A muscle layer that is part of an intestine.

name: circular muscle layer of muscular coat
definition: The inner layer of the muscular coat.

name: longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat
definition: The outer layer of the muscular coat.

name: sympathetic nerve plexus
definition: A nerve plexus that is part of a sympathetic nervous system.

name: subserosa
definition: A layer of tissue between the muscularis and serosa.

name: muscle layer of jejunum
definition: A muscular coat that is part of a jejunum.

name: muscle layer of urinary bladder
definition: A muscular coat that is part of a urinary bladder.

name: large intestine smooth muscle circular layer
synonyms: circular muscle layer of segment of large intestine
definition: A circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a large intestine smooth muscle.

name: large intestine smooth muscle longitudinal layer
synonyms: longitudinal muscle layer of zone of large intestine
definition: A longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a large intestine smooth muscle.

name: small intestine smooth muscle circular layer
synonyms: circular layer of small intestine muscularis propria
circular muscle coat of small intestine
circular muscle layer of small intestine
short pitch helicoidal muscle layer of small intestine
stratum circulare tunicae muscularis intestini tenuis
stratum helicoidale brevis gradus tunicae muscularis intestini tenuis
definition: A circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a small intestine smooth muscle.

name: small intestine smooth muscle longitudinal layer
synonyms: long pitch helicoidal muscle layer of small intestine
longitudinal layer of small intestine muscularis propria
longitudinal muscle coat of small intestine
longitudinal muscle layer of small intestine
stratum helicoidale longi gradus tunicae muscularis intestini tenuis
stratum longitudinale tunicae muscularis intestini tenuis
definition: A longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a small intestine smooth muscle.

name: respiratory system venous smooth muscle
definition: A smooth muscle tissue that is part of a respiratory system venous blood vessel.

name: taenia coli
synonyms: longitudinal band of large intestine muscularis
definition: The taeniae coli (also teniae coli) are three separate longitudinal ribbons of smooth muscle on the outside of the ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid colons. They are visible, and can be seen just below the serosa or fibrosa. They are the Mesocolic, Free and Omental Coli. The teniae coli contracts length wise to produce the haustra, the bulges in the colon. The bands converge at the root of the vermiform appendix and the rectum. These bands correspond to the outer layer of the muscularis externa, in other portions of the digestive tract.

name: layer of microvilli
definition: A layer of microvilli, Thin cylindrical membrane-covered projections on the surface of an animal cell containing a core bundle of actin filaments[GO,modified].

name: striated border microvillus layer
definition: A microvillus layer that is striated and found in the intestine.

name: hematopoietic tissue
definition: Blood-forming tissue, consisting of reticular fibers and cells.

name: tunica fibrosa of eyeball
definition: The sclera and cornea form the fibrous tunic of the bulb of the eye; the sclera is opaque, and constitutes the posterior five-sixths of the tunic; the cornea is transparent, and forms the anterior sixth.

name: endothelium of peritubular capillary
definition: An endothelium that is part of a peritubular capillary.

name: cloacal lumen
definition: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a cloaca.

name: cloacal vent
definition: The opening of the cloacal chamber to the outside of the organism. Birds maintain a single cloacal opening throughout their lives.

name: lumen of terminal part of digestive tract
definition: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a terminal part of digestive tract.

name: enclosed anatomical space
definition: An anatomical space with no opening to another space or to the exterior.

name: anal tooth
definition: Triangular calcified papillae (often five) placed radially around the anus of some Holothuriidae.

name: skeleton of pectoral complex

name: sweat gland of eyelid
definition: Glands of Moll, also known as ciliary glands, are modified apocrine sweat glands that are found on the margin of the eyelid. They are next to the base of the eyelashes, and anterior to the Meibomian glands within the distal eyelid margin. These glands are relatively large and tubular-shaped. The glands of Moll are named after Dutch oculist Jacob Anton Moll (1832-1914). Glands of Moll empty into the adjacent lashes. Glands of Moll and Zeis secrete lipid that adds to the superficial layer of the tear film, retarding evaporation. The glands of Moll are prone to infection and blockage of its duct with sebum and cell debris. Blockage of the gland's duct causes swelling which can manifest itself as a stye.
